companies_settings_valid.name: companies_settings_valid
companies_settings_valid.value:
"companies"."settings"->>'individualVisibility' in ('aggregates-only', 'full')
        and "companies"."settings"->>'projectNaming' in ('plain', 'hashed')
        and jsonb_typeof("companies"."settings"->'retentionDays') = 'number'
        and ("companies"."settings"->>'retentionDays')::numeric between 30 and 730
        and ("companies"."settings"->'runawayCostUsd' is null or (jsonb_typeof("companies"."settings"->'runawayCostUsd') = 'number'
          and ("companies"."settings"->>'runawayCostUsd')::numeric between 1 and 100000))
        and ("companies"."settings"->'runawayHours' is null or (jsonb_typeof("companies"."settings"->'runawayHours') = 'number'
          and ("companies"."settings"->>'runawayHours')::numeric between 0.5 and 72))

usage_has_owner.name: usage_has_owner
usage_has_owner.value: "usage"."turn_id" is not null or "usage"."run_id" is not null

budgets_has_scope.name: budgets_has_scope
budgets_has_scope.value: "budgets"."team_id" is not null or "budgets"."user_id" is not null
